BiblicalUsage: Ezri is named once, in 1 Chronicles 27:26, as the son of Chelub who was over the work of the field for the tillage of the ground under David. He is one of the stewards who kept the king's lands and made the kingdom run. No deed of his is told, only his charge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe kingdoms run on faithful stewards whose names are nearly forgotten. Ezri tilled the ground so that David's house could stand, and I hold that quiet, unseen work is the backbone of God's people.
